title: cart2del_damp_2d
description: `cart2del_damp_2d` renders delay time, damping, and direction for direct sound and two sets of early reflections in a two-dimensional room simulation. It accepts room dimensions and source/listener Cartesian coordinates in meters, with configurable sonic speed and minimum radius; its routed outputs identify `direct`, `early1`, and `early2` data including delay, damping, and angular information.
